description: Registry of every signal that may be written to the observations table (src/brands.py). An observation's signal must be named here. point_in_time_safe is the default for observations of that signal: true only when the observation's source_date is when the fact became true in the world AND that date could have been known on that date, so a backtest may use it as of source_date without seeing the future. Grouped by source so parallel work appends to its own section; signal names must be unique across all groups.
_comment: Each signal: {"source": <observations.source value>, "point_in_time_safe": bool, "description": str}. Keys starting with '_' are comments.

trademark._comment: Facts from the UKIPO Trade Marks Journal record itself. Filing and publication dates are fixed historical facts.

filing_date.description: The trade mark application was filed. Value: {trademark_number, filing_date}. source_date = filing date.

publication_date.description: The application was published in the journal. Value: {trademark_number, journal_number}. source_date = journal publication date.

nice_classes.description: Nice classes as published. Value: {trademark_number, classes}. source_date = journal publication date (classes can be amended before publication, so not the filing date).

companies_house._comment: Companies House facts for a confident company match. Only the incorporation date is historical; everything else is the register as it stands when we looked, so it is not point-in-time safe.

incorporation_date.description: The matched company was incorporated. Value: {company_number, incorporation_date}. source_date = incorporation date.

company_match.description: The applicant was matched to this company. Value: {company_number, match_confidence, match_method}. Matching runs against today's register.

company_status.description: Company status (active, dissolved, ...) as on the register when observed.

sic_codes.description: SIC codes as on the register when observed; companies change them.

accounts_category.description: Latest accounts category (micro entity, small, ...) when observed.

web_search._comment: What a web search found when we looked. None of it carries a trustworthy date of its own. Recorded only when a search was attempted; a null value means searched and not found.

website.description: Verified website for the brand, or null if none was verified.

website_maturity.description: early_stage / established / unknown, from attributed search results.

retail_presence.description: RetailPresence value resolved from attributed search results.

products_on_sale.description: The verified site shows products for sale (true/false/null).

launch_evidence.description: Launch phrases found in attributed results (list).

score._comment: LaunchTrace's own derivations. Never point-in-time safe: they depend on the code and on non-PIT inputs.

launchtrace_score.description: Score for one mark in one run. Value: {trademark_number, score, band, suppressed}.

launch_stage.description: Assessed launch stage (pre_launch, early_launch, scaling, established, unknown).

domain._comment: Reserved for the domain layer (RDAP, DNS, homepage probes). Phase 2 domain-layer agent appends signals here, e.g. an RDAP registration date with point_in_time_safe true and source 'rdap'.

rescan._comment: Reserved for the rescan job (Phase 3). Signals observed by later re-checks of a known brand go here, with source 'rescan' (or 'outcome' for labelled outcomes).
